title: Risk-Aware Alignment Must Incorporate Reward Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2410.23726v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of policy optimization with noisy rewards, where the policy is constrained to be in the neighborhood of a reference policy.We study the risk of the policy optimization process, defined to be the chance of obtaining a policy worse off than the reference policy. In an idealized multivariate Gaussian model for the noisy reward function, we show that the regularizer achieving optimal risk in a suitably local neighborhood of the reference policy is the quadratic norm weighted by the reward covariance matrix. This result is used to develop a new policy optimization algorithm based on regularization via reward variance estimates. Experiments across synthetic bandit models, large language models and reward models show that this algorithm yields more robust alignment outcomes than existing approaches.

translated_title: 风险感知的对齐必须纳入奖励不确定性
translated_abstract: 我们考虑带有噪声奖励的策略优化问题，其中策略被约束在参考策略的邻域内。我们研究策略优化过程的风险，其定义为获得比参考策略更差的策略的概率。在噪声奖励函数的理想化多元高斯模型中，我们证明了在参考策略的适当局部邻域内实现最优风险的正则化器是由奖励协方差矩阵加权的二次范数。基于这一结果，我们开发了一种新的策略优化算法，该算法通过奖励方差估计来进行正则化。在合成老虎机模型、大语言模型和奖励模型上的实验表明，该算法比现有方法能产生更鲁棒的对齐结果。
tldr: 该论文证明了在参考策略局部邻域内实现最优风险的正则化器是由奖励协方差矩阵加权的二次范数，并据此提出一种基于奖励方差估计正则化的新策略优化算法，在大语言模型等实验中展现出比现有方法更鲁棒的对齐效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the optimal regularizer for risk-aware policy optimization near a reference policy is the quadratic norm weighted by the reward covariance matrix, and proposes a new policy optimization algorithm based on reward variance regularization that achieves more robust alignment outcomes than existing approaches.
